allow: PowerShell($portPid = \(netstat -ano | Select-String ":3333 " | Select-String "LISTENING" | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split "\\s+"\)[-1] } | Select-Object -First 1\); if \($portPid\) { Stop-Process -Id \([int]$portPid\) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Killed PID $portPid" } else { Write-Host "Nothing on 3333" })
